sarif-schema-2.1.0.json in this directory is the official JSON schema for the
Static Analysis Results Interchange Format (SARIF) Version 2.1.0, Plus Errata 01,
an OASIS Standard. It is copied unchanged from:

  https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

SHA-256 of the copied file:
  c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e

It is used only by ProdPilot's tests, to validate the SARIF ProdPilot writes. It
is not part of the ProdPilot package.
